title: Necromancer NPC
description: A gameplay mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that introduces a challenging new night-time mini-boss: the Necromancer.
body:
# Necromancer

The night just became much more dangerous. This mod introduces a powerful dark mage that rules the dark hours of Minecraft. Watch your step after sunset, because purple souls might rise from beneath the ground at any moment.

### The Night Terror: Necromancer
When the sun goes down, a rare and formidable boss spawns in your world: the Necromancer. This is no ordinary mob. During combat, he commands the undead, summoning temporary minions from deep underground to overwhelm you. Defeating him will require skill and preparation.

### Command the Souls
If you manage to slay this dark sorcerer, you can claim his ancient staff. With this weapon in your hands, the power of necromancy is yours to command:

* **Summon Your Army:** Right-click the staff to raise temporary, fast-running minions from the ground.
* **Spectral Appearance:** These unique minions spawn entirely covered in a glowing purple energy.
* **Loyal Guardians:** These spirits spawn on your side and will aggressively sprint towards nearby hostiles to defend you.
* **Temporary Lifespan:** These souls cannot stay in our world forever; they will vanish back into the ground after a short period.

### Compatibility and Installation
* **Minecraft Version:** 1.20.1
* **Mod Loader:** Forge
* Safe to add to existing worlds.
